back: No gain or loss when property is contributed in exchange for a partnership interest.

front: When does a contributing partner recognize gain at formation?
back: When net liability relief exceeds the partner's basis (deemed cash distribution, §731). Outside basis then = 0.
Carryover — the contributing partner's adjusted basis. Holding period tacks.
Ordinary income equal to the FMV of the interest; that amount becomes outside basis.
Allocates pre-contribution built-in gain or loss to the contributing partner when the property is sold.
Organization: deduct up to $5,000 (phased out over $50,000) and amortize the rest over 180 months. Syndication: never deductible.
Ordinary income if the partnership sells it within 5 years of contribution (§724).
